content: AdaBoost one-round sample-weight update, binary labels and a weak classifier. Start with weighted training samples represented by neutral/blue circles of differing size. Feed weight distribution and examples to a small weak learner tree, which predicts samples. Split predictions into correct branch (green) and misclassified branch (rose); correct branch shows shrinking relative sample weights, misclassified shows increasing weights. Both branches converge to ONE normalization node, then a new distribution of weights and loop back to training for the next round. A separate learner contribution joins final weighted-vote ensemble output. Reserve adequate large slots for correct/incorrect multipliers and normalization formula. This is relative reweighting, not removing incorrect samples. Show no printed labels or math symbols. A clean loop with useful weight comparison, not many generic boxes.
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL academic machine-learning mechanism diagram; choose a fresh composition yourself. External reference images are used ONLY to understand the relevant mechanism, NOT to copy their layout, typography, gradients or colors. Output entirely UNLABELLED PNG with transparent canvas. Draw NO text, letters, numerals, mathematical glyphs, pseudo text, watermark. Reserve clear label slots next to real mechanism objects and within empty processing nodes; leave roomy margins for actual Chinese labels later. Flat 2D technical illustration: thin neutral #4C4D4F connections, simple filled arrowheads with exact endpoints, no lines crossing unrelated nodes. White/open regions plus a FEW pale solid grouping regions, never a grid of decorative cards. Repeated same-semantic nodes use the same color and omit decorative icons consistently. Necessary tensors, sample tokens, trees, split diagrams are mechanism objects. Palette #7B95C6 blue, #49C2D9 cyan, #67A583 green, #F59C7C orange, #C85E62 rose, pale uniform 18–30% white-mixed tints. Every colored continuous shape has constant flat color. NO gradient, paper/canvas texture, wave, grain, clouding, stripes, gloss, shadows, halos, glow, 3D, perspective. Exactly follow dependencies described below, do not invent relations merely for symmetry.

Replace vivid cyan/blue with muted BLUE, pale backgrounds; primary computational modules BLUE, secondary sources GREEN sparingly, position/selection/alternate third class YELLOW; generic outputs BLUE not red. RED only actual gradient/loss/error/exclusion, PURPLE only fourth/fifth semantic category. Distinct categorical colors preserve distinct categories in priority BLUE GREEN YELLOW RED PURPLE. Make ordinary rectangular modules rounded while matrix cells, data bars, tensor planes, samples and scientific factor symbols retain geometry. Flat fills no noise or glow. Images of samples/neuron anatomy/function traces are scientific content: preserve their geometry and values, retain natural sample colors. NO letters/digits/operators added; spaces are intentionally reserved for true fonts. Reference2 is style context only, do not add its objects.
